title: Irish Bacon and Fried Egg Toast
description: A simple yet satisfying breakfast featuring crispy Irish bacon and a fried egg on toasted bread.
instructions: 1. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the drop of oil.
2. Cook the Irish bacon slices for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until crispy.
3. Crack the egg into a bowl and whisk it lightly.
4. Pour the egg mixture into the pan with the cooked bacon.
5. Cook the egg for 2-3 minutes, or until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to your desired doneness.
6. Meanwhile, toast the bread slices until lightly browned.
7. To assemble the dish, place a slice of toasted bread on a plate, top with a slice of Irish bacon, and finish with the fried egg.
